articles.summary: CAR27 NK cells with CD28-based costimulation were approximately three times more likely to exhibit serial killing behavior and resulted in significantly better long-term cytotoxicity, polyfunctionality, and survival in animals
articles.title: Cancer Discovery publication applies TIMING to show increased serial killing by novel CAR NK therapy

articles.summary: The National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences (NCATS) of the NIH has awarded CellChorus and the University of Houston an STTR Fast-Track grant to advance the development of the Time-lapse Imaging Microscopy In Nanowell Grids™ (TIMING™) platform for dynamic single-cell analysis.
articles.title: CellChorus and UH Awarded $2.5 Million STTR — CellChorus
